what: A hidden 6px dot sits where the arrow dot is on the right of the white pill button. On hover it appears at once and spreads to 80x over .5s cubic-bezier(.87,.24,.36,1) to fill the whole button, the text turns white over .3s ease-in, and the arrow icon hides immediately. On release the dot fades over .3s (cubic-bezier(.26,.06,0,1)) and its size resets .3s after it has fully faded

options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Spread dot (child, required) — position set by the consuming css (center of the arrow icon)
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Arrow icon to hide during the spread (optional)
options.--fx-scale: Spread multiplier (via style), default 80 — raise it if the button is long
options.--fx-ink: Text color after fill, default var(--kf-on-accent)

use: View details

from.where: shared.css .kg-pill (white pill for Service intro, Learn more, About us, Company site — original .bg_white_link_btn .circle:after: 6px orange dot scale(80) .5s cubic-bezier(.87,.24,.36,1), text white, padding 2rem 4.7rem 2rem 3rem → 2rem 3.8rem .3s ease-in, arrow image opacity 0, no spreading below 544px)

note: No ripple on touch (hover: none) — the original also turns it off below 544px. The button has overflow: hidden so the ripple spot never spills outside the pill
